«وَ سَمِعَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلاً يَقُولُ» is a scene: the Imam hears a man and then answers («كَذَبْتَ»). Whether the Imam is a source of the report or only in the scene is not settled by the rules; no link written (rule 6)
